pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/oembed/route.ts:6 This context is a stateless oEmbed 1.0 GET handler. It loads a published list by slug and returns JSON, and there is no agent, no persisted belief store and no recall or injection. Grepping src/app for memory, memories, recall, episod, consolidat and remember found nothing, and a repo-wide grep of src for agent-memory, memories, episodic and consolidat also found nothing, so the subject's precondition (a long-lived agent carrying memory forward) does not hold here.
